name: io.github.rebasepro/rebase
description: Operate a Rebase backend from an AI assistant: introspect and edit the Postgres schema, read and write collection data under row-level security, manage storage, cron jobs and database branches — through scoped API keys, under the same authorization a human gets.

environmentVariables.name: REBASE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Rebase backend, e.g. http://localhost:3001 or https://your-app.rebase.website

environmentVariables.name: REBASE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A scoped Rebase API key (rk_…). Prefer a key limited to the collections and operations the assistant should reach — the agent then gets exactly the authorization the key carries, enforced by Postgres row-level security rather than by the tool.

environmentVariables.name: REBASE_PROJECT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local Rebase project, for the schema and migration tools that read collection definitions from disk.

environmentVariables.name: REBASE_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to allow write tools against a non-local backend. Off by default: a remote write is the one action an assistant should not be able to take by accident.
